name: Procurement
description: Multi-source procurement catalog with BC Bid, CanadaBuys and bids&tenders (25 BC public buyers) collection, saved searches, pursuits and source-aware analysis.

actions.title: Open BC Bid opportunities
actions.description: Navigate the selected Zoer browser to public opportunities. Browser checks remain manual.

actions.title: Capture current listing page
actions.description: Parse only the current BC Bid public page and save records in the database. Complete browser checks manually. This does not crawl other pages.

actions.title: Capture current detail page
actions.description: Parse only the current BC Bid public page and save records in the database. Complete browser checks manually. This does not crawl other pages.

actions.title: Scrape a listing page and details
actions.description: Capture the first public listing page and up to three opportunity details. Saves checkpoints in Zoer; browser checks require manual completion. Additional listing pages are not crawled.

actions.title: Import contract award batch
actions.description: Validate and save up to 200 uploaded award records into this plugin’s database.

actions.title: Scrape all current public opportunities
actions.description: Crawl all current listing pages and opportunity details, saving attachment links and resumable checkpoints. Up to 200 listing pages, 3000 opportunities, six hours. Browser checks require manual completion.

stopNotification.title: BC Bid scrape stopped before finishing

cases.title: BC Bid needs a browser check
BC Bid scrape paused at its run limit

actions.title: Refresh one BC Bid buyer or region
actions.description: Search BC Bid's public opportunities for one buyer (organization), region or keyword, confirm BC Bid applied that filter, and save up to 20 result pages plus details for new or changed notices (at most 40). Aborts without saving if the filter is not confirmed; clears the search afterwards. Browser checks require manual completion.

cases.title: BC Bid needs a browser check

cases.match: did not confirm|not trusted|shows the|still has
cases.title: BC Bid did not apply the requested filter

actions.title: Download public award history
actions.description: Backfill public awards in resumable date ranges, skipping completed ranges and unchanged records. Optionally refresh the last 30 days. Undated records are not verified; attachments are separate.

actions.title: Save bid star
actions.description: Save or remove a star on an opportunity or award in Zoer.

actions.title: Download selected bid documents
actions.description: Process 1–50 saved database records in a resumable batch. Existing successful results are reused unless forced.

actions.title: Download all opportunity attachments
actions.description: Download saved attachment links for up to 3,000 opportunities in one durable, resumable batch. Saved files are reused.

cases.title: BC Bid needs a browser check
An attachment is too large to download

cases.match: attachment control is missing|capture the notice details
cases.title: Some notices need their details captured again

actions.title: Review selected bids with AI
actions.description: Process 1–50 saved database records in a resumable batch. Existing successful results are reused unless forced.

actions.title: Unify saved bid database
actions.description: Migrate existing records and history into database storage while retaining source files.

actions.title: Import opportunity JSON
actions.description: Validate and merge opportunity JSON directly into the database.

actions.title: Review selected bids with installed CLI
actions.description: Use the selected computer’s supported CLI and model to review saved evidence with shell and web tools disabled.

actions.title: Collect public procurement sources
actions.description: Fetch the official CanadaBuys open-tender CSV, or the open-notice listings and public notice pages of 25 BC public buyers on bids&tenders, and merge them into the existing catalog. sourceId "all" collects every source in one run (for one schedule): CanadaBuys continues the same daily file or restarts on a new one, then every connector; a failing source or portal is recorded and does not stop the others, and the run fails only when every source fails. CanadaBuys resume checks the source checksum; each bids&tenders portal is saved on its own. Saved notices are never deleted. bids&tenders search needs a per-run cookie session and form POST.

sourceId.description: "all" collects CanadaBuys and then every connector in one run; portals is not allowed with it.

portals.description: bids&tenders portal ids to collect; all portals when omitted.

actions.title: Check saved procurement searches
actions.description: Explicitly check saved searches and add deduplicated new-notice alerts. This does not enable a schedule.

actions.title: Save procurement workflow state
actions.description: Version-checked saved search and pursuit changes, and notices hidden as not relevant, in the existing workspace catalog.

actions.title: Analyze procurement evidence
actions.description: Analyze up to three saved notices using available downloaded evidence and retain traceable source references. No bid submission.

actions.title: Analyze procurement evidence with CLI
actions.description: Analyze up to three saved notices using available downloaded evidence and retain traceable source references. No bid submission.

actions.title: Save procurement classification mapping
actions.description: Version-checked source-specific classification labels in the existing catalog. Raw records are retained.

actions.title: Tag places and contacts on saved notices
actions.description: Adds BC place (municipality, regional district) and published buyer contacts to saved BC Bid and CanadaBuys opportunities in resumable batches. Only those fields change; unchanged records are not rewritten.

actions.title: Extract saved document text
actions.description: Re-extract saved originals without downloading them again. Limited or unreadable content remains visible.

actions.title: Prepare the review workspace
actions.description: Create or upgrade the review workspace tables in this plugin's catalog and report its capabilities. Existing records are not changed.

actions.title: Prepare evidence and extract requirements
actions.description: Triage saved notices from the notice alone, or extract atomic requirements and facts from the notice and every readable document with exact source spans. Results are proposals for human review; nothing is submitted.

actions.title: Prepare evidence and extract requirements with installed CLI
actions.description: Triage saved notices from the notice alone, or extract atomic requirements and facts from the notice and every readable document with exact source spans. Results are proposals for human review; nothing is submitted.

actions.title: Save a review decision
actions.description: Version-checked review events, requirement matches, company profiles, human decisions, tasks and change acknowledgements. Never contacts a buyer or submits a bid.

browser_session_id.description: Zoer browser session used by this workspace. Empty selects the only ready browser.
